name: Identity
description: Selfhood, Name, Face, Allegiance, Who You Were and Who You Are. Identity is History brought into Clarity: the whole of a life resolved into a single answer to the question of who. Those attuned hold that answer like a blade. They can make a foe forget its own training, its allies and its name, wear another's face so well that the world agrees, and anchor a friend so firmly in themselves that no charm, curse or shapeshifting can move them. Its enemy is Oblivion — the forgetting of the self — and its wielders know that one day they will have to answer the question too.

minor.name: Doubting
minor.card: loses one proficiency of your choice

major.name: Mistaken
major.card: can't tell friend from foe — attacks the nearest creature

severe.name: Unnamed
severe.card: Incapacitated, unable to remember who it is

offensive.name: Self-Doubt
offensive.description: You ask them who they are. They can't answer fast enough.

tiers.text: The damage becomes psychic. A creature hit or that fails forgets one proficiency of your choice — a skill, weapon, armour or saving throw — until the end of its next turn.
tiers.card: Damage becomes Psychic · they forget one proficiency until their next turn

tiers.text: It also can't use one class feature, Grimm ability or Cognition of your choice until the end of its next turn — it no longer remembers being someone who could.
tiers.card: Also no use of one class feature, Grimm ability or Cognition

deny: one class feature, Grimm ability or Cognition

tiers.text: A creature hit or that fails is Mistaken until the end of its next turn: it can't tell friend from foe, and uses its action to attack the nearest creature.
tiers.card: MISTAKEN — attacks the nearest creature, friend or foe

conditions.name: Mistaken
conditions.duration: until the end of its next turn

tiers.text: Unnamed. A creature hit or that fails loses its name for 1 minute: no class features, Grimm abilities or Cognitions, no benefit from its allies' spells or Help, and it is Incapacitated on any turn it starts at half its hit points or fewer. It repeats the Charisma save at the end of each of its turns.
tiers.card: UNNAMED 1 min — no features, no allies' help · Incapacitated at half HP (Cha save each turn)

conditions.name: Unnamed
conditions.escape: Charisma save at the end of each of its turns

supportive.name: I Am
supportive.description: You say their name back to them until it holds like stone.

tiers.text: For 1 minute the target can't be Charmed or possessed, and adds your Verum Modifier to Charisma saving throws.
tiers.card: 1 min: can't be Charmed or possessed · +{VM} to Charisma saves

tiers.text: It can't be transformed against its will — polymorph, petrification, lycanthropy and curses that change what it is fail against it — and it ignores the effects of Dream Exhaustion on its checks.
tiers.card: Can't be transformed against its will · ignores Dream Exhaustion on its checks

tiers.text: At the start of each of its turns, it may end one condition on itself that changed who it was: Charmed, Frightened, Mistaken, Confused, or a curse of the slot level or lower.
tiers.card: At the start of each turn, end one identity-changing condition on itself

tiers.text: The Unbreakable Self. For the minute, the target has advantage on every saving throw, and its attacks and seals are made as if it were at its best: it ignores exhaustion, Dream Exhaustion, and any penalty to its rolls from another creature's effect.
tiers.card: THE UNBREAKABLE SELF — advantage on EVERY save · ignores exhaustion and every penalty others lay on its rolls

control.name: Stranger in the Mirror
control.description: They look at their friends and see no one they know.

tiers.text: A creature that fails treats its allies as strangers until the end of its next turn: it can't benefit from their spells, Help or features, and can't take reactions on their behalf.
tiers.card: Fail: its allies are strangers until their next turn — no help from them, no reactions for them

tiers.text: A creature that fails is Mistaken until the end of its next turn, attacking the nearest creature.
tiers.card: MISTAKEN until their next turn — attacks the nearest creature

conditions.name: Mistaken
conditions.duration: until the end of its next turn

tiers.text: The confusion lasts 1 minute, repeating the Charisma save at the end of each of its turns, and you choose whom it believes it is fighting for.
tiers.card: 1 min (Cha save each turn) · you decide whose side it thinks it's on

conditions.name: Mistaken
conditions.escape: Charisma save at the end of each of its turns

tiers.text: The Exchange. A creature that fails takes your side for 1 minute: it is Charmed by you and treats its former allies as enemies, repeating the save each time one of them damages it.
tiers.card: THE EXCHANGE — 1 min: Charmed by you, fighting its former allies (repeat when they hurt it)

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.escape: Charisma save when an ally damages it

control.name: Stolen Face
control.description: You take what makes them recognisable, and wear it better.

tiers.text: Choose one creature that fails: for 1 hour you may take on its face, voice and mannerisms perfectly. Only Truesight or a creature that knows it intimately can tell, with an Insight check against your DC.
tiers.card: Wear the face, voice and manner of one who failed for 1 hr (Insight vs {DC} to tell)

tiers.text: While you wear it, the creature's own allies are uncertain which of you is real: they have disadvantage on attack rolls against either of you.
tiers.card: Its allies have disadvantage on attacks against either of you

penalty.disadvantage: its allies' attacks against either of you

tiers.text: You take one of its proficiencies, senses or movement modes along with the face, and it loses it for the duration.
tiers.card: Take one of its proficiencies, senses or speeds — it loses it meanwhile

tiers.text: You take its name. For the hour, oaths, wards, pacts and doors that know it recognise you instead, and not it.
tiers.card: Take its NAME — oaths, wards, pacts and doors know you as it, and not it

creation.name: Mirror-Made
creation.description: Everything you make knows exactly what it is — and who it belongs to.

tiers.text: Your Constructs may wear your likeness or that of any creature you know well, speaking with its voice. Your Objects bear an identity: a crest, seal or signature no forgery can match.
tiers.card: Constructs wear a likeness you know · Objects bear an unforgeable seal

tiers.text: Your Structures know who belongs: creatures you name may pass freely; anyone else is known to you the moment they enter.
tiers.card: Structures admit whoever you name, and tell you of anyone else

tiers.text: A Construct made in someone's likeness carries one of their memories or skills, as a proficiency they have.
tiers.card: A likeness-Construct carries one of its model's skills or memories

tiers.text: Make a true Echo of yourself, lasting 1 hour: it shares your mind, can cast one seal of the slot level or lower, and knows everything you know.
tiers.card: A true ECHO of you, 1 hr — shares your mind, casts one seal

utility.name: Clarity of Self
utility.description: Who are you, really? You can always tell.

tiers.text: Know whether a creature you see is disguised, shapechanged, possessed, or not what it claims to be. Or take on the look of anyone you have seen, for 1 hour.
tiers.card: See through disguise, shapechange and possession · or wear any seen face for 1 hr

tiers.text: Hold an object and learn the identity of the last three people who owned it, and one thing each did with it.
tiers.card: Learn an object's last three owners and one thing each did

tiers.text: Restore a lost memory, a forgotten name, or the mind of a creature suffering amnesia or a magical change of identity.
tiers.card: Restore a lost memory, name, or a stolen identity

tiers.text: Read the whole history of a creature you touch — birthplace, true name, the turning points of its life — in an instant.
tiers.card: Read a touched creature's whole history and true name

complementEffects.name: Doubt
complementEffects.description: A small voice asks whether they are really who they think.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw, the target takes bonus psychic damage equal to one damage die of the primary effect's type (min 1d6).

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Two dice, and it forgets one proficiency of your choice until the end of its next turn.
upgrades.card: +2 dice · they forget one proficiency until their next turn

complementEffects.name: Remember Yourself
complementEffects.description: The seal reminds each of them who they are.

effect.text: Each of the seal's targets gains temporary hit points equal to your Verum Modifier + the slot level, and advantage on saves against being Charmed or possessed until the end of its next turn.
effect.card: The seal's targets: {VM} + {SLOT} temp HP · advantage vs charm and possession until their next turn

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Each may also end one Charmed, Frightened or Mistaken condition on itself.
upgrades.card: Each may end Charmed, Frightened or Mistaken on itself

upgrades.text: Level 11+: The advantage lasts 1 minute and covers transformation too.

complementEffects.name: Misplaced
complementEffects.description: For a moment they don't remember whose side they are on.

effect.text: A creature hit by or failing the seal can't take reactions and can't benefit from its allies' Help until the start of its next turn.
effect.card: No reactions and no help from its allies until their next turn

upgrades.text: Level 5+: It has disadvantage on its next attack roll against you or the seal's targets.
upgrades.card: Disadvantage on its next attack against you or the seal's targets

upgrades.text: Level 11+: It is Mistaken until the end of its next turn.
upgrades.card: Mistaken until the end of their next turn
